final_text: The design is fixed and all tests pass. The bug was in `rtl/pwm.v:21`: `pwm_out = (cnt <= duty_q)` produced one extra high cycle per period (and incorrectly asserted output when `duty_q == 0`). Changing it to `cnt < duty_q` matches the spec, and `TEST PASSED` confirms both duty cases (100, 200) now measure the correct number of high cycles.
